baseline.method: Independently executed selected CaImAn release pipeline on complete real Sue movie

zero_estimate_policy: Zero temporal or background estimates have NCC=0 and ordinary dynamic-range NRMSE, and fail with exit code 1; zero spatial columns violate the declared gauge. Zero-norm or constant hidden references are evaluator errors.
alignment: Unit spatial L2 gauge; fixed maximum-total-spatial-cosine Hungarian assignment; only cosine>=0.7 counts as matched; unmatched sources penalized by detection F1. Background evaluated through sum of rank-2 products, preserving general factorization ambiguity.
threshold_provenance: NCC, detection F1, matching and motion criteria fixed before complete local pipeline assessment. NRMSE boundaries added at packaging after developmental diagnostics and before final CLI/notebook judging, then checked on independent reruns; they are not presented as a preregistered experiment. 0.11 pixel allows one original 0.1-pixel registration quantum. Stage parity tests separately require much tighter agreement. References are method results, not neuronal truth.
metric_definitions: NCC is flattened cosine, without mean subtraction. NRMSE is RMS divided by reference dynamic range. Source metrics use all matched source arrays, detection F1=2*matches/(K+Kref). Background metrics use full rank-2 product in float64 and accumulated blocks. No intensity rescaling, cropping, temporal shift, or magnitude conversion.
